title: Faceless Appeals before CIT(A): Drafting Form 35 Grounds and Statement of Facts
summary: Strategic formulation of grounds of appeal, rebuttal submissions, and video conference advocacy before NFAC.
body:
Filing an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) under the Faceless Appeal Scheme requires crisp legal structuring.

For legal representation before the National Faceless Assessment Centre (NFAC), contact our [Serampore & Rishra advisory desk](/locations/serampore-rishra) or our [Uttarpara & Konnagar Desk](/locations/uttarpara-konnagar).

All submissions must be uploaded digitally via the e-Filing portal within 30 days. Reach out to [schedule a consultation](/schedule) with our appellate advocates.
